title: New product development
body: Requirement capture, architecture, design, prototype and validation planning, run as one gated programme.

title: PCB and enclosure design
body: Schematic capture, layout for power and control stages, and enclosures designed for thermal, safety and serviceability needs.

title: CAE and simulation
body: Circuit, thermal and structural analysis to find design risks before hardware is built.

title: ATE and reliability
body: Test strategy, fixture and test-program definition, and reliability planning from DFMEA through validation.

title: Sourcing
body: BOM review, alternates and second sources, supplier comparison and lead-time planning.

title: Virtual OEM
body: Your product and brand, with ATHENA coordinating design, test, manufacturing partners and documentation.
